serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: Files.com is a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) platform with one unified application and API to manage, store, and transfer files across your organization.

trustCenter.repositoryDescription: Files.com's FedRAMP-compatible Trust Center, providing access to FedRAMP Certification Data including the Security Decision Record, POA&M summary, and SOC 2 Type II report.
trustCenter.accessRequestInstructions: Submit the Trust Center access request form with first name, last name, work email, company name, and reason for access (existing customer, prospective customer, or other). Requests are reviewed by the Files.com security team before access is granted. Existing accessors can use the 'Reclaim access' option on the same page.

secureConfigurationGuidance.repositoryDescription: Guidance for securely configuring Files.com, including administrative account settings and security-related options.

additionalRepositories.repositoryDescription: Public product documentation covering setup, security, encryption, data governance, logging, and other Files.com platform capabilities.
